source_name: FIN-NET members — Slovakia (European Commission page)
why_relevant: Lists the SK out-of-court dispute-resolution bodies for financial services — which in Slovakia includes association-run schemes such as the SBA Institute of Alternative Dispute Resolution. Authoritative pointer linking self-regulatory bodies to the EU consumer-protection framework.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Finančné ukazovatele / Investori (disclosure hub)
why_relevant: Central hub of SLSP (largest SK bank, Erste Group, O-SII) for annual reports, quarterly 'informácie a finančné ukazovatele' and Pillar 3 / Opatrenie NBS 16-2014 disclosures — dates prudential capital, MREL and risk data.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Zmluvné podmienky (T&C + change notices)
why_relevant: Carries 'Informácia o zmene zmluvných podmienok' and Cenník / Podmienky vykonávania platobných služieb with forward-dated effectivity (e.g. changes effective 1.1.2026 and 1.7.2026) — precise compliance-deadline signal for payments rules.

source_name: VÚB banka – Pillar III / Zverejňovanie informácií podľa Opatrenia NBS č. 16/2014
why_relevant: VÚB (Intesa Sanpaolo, O-SII) publishes a highly regular, predictably-named quarterly Pillar 3 PDF series — the cleanest machine-harvestable prudential disclosure set in SK.

source_name: VÚB banka – Aktualizácia dokumentov / Informačný servis (aktuality)
why_relevant: VÚB's running list of document updates — announces new VOP, product conditions and cenník with effective dates (e.g. credit-card conditions from 1.1.2026, deposit VOP from 9.10.2025). Ideal deadline ticker.

source_name: Tatra banka – Ostatné informácie (zverejňovanie podľa Opatrenia NBS 16/2014)
why_relevant: Tatra banka (RBI, O-SII) group-level Pillar 3 / quarterly 'informácie o banke k <dátum>' disclosures — capital, liquidity, risk exposure for the third systemic private bank.

source_name: Tatra banka – Archív obchodných podmienok + 'Prehľad zmien' documents
why_relevant: Tatra banka publishes explicit 'prehľad zmien' / 'opis zmeny' comparison PDFs alongside each new T&C version (e.g. One banking 07/2025, consumer info effective 5.10.2025) — rare structured before/after change logs that date regulatory bite precisely.

source_name: ČSOB SK – Dôležité dokumenty (VOP, sadzobníky, podmienky)
why_relevant: Consolidated ČSOB (KBC) document register: VOP, product conditions, sadzobník, KID/SFDR pre-contractual disclosures, each with marked effective dates.

source_name: ČSOB SK – 'Prehľad zmien v podmienkach' / navrhované zmeny VOP notices
why_relevant: ČSOB issues discrete pre-notification documents naming the proposed VOP change and its effective date (e.g. 1.7.2025, 7.10.2025 current-account conditions, accessibility-of-services clause implementing the EU Accessibility Act). Directly maps regulation to contractual deadline.

source_name: ČSOB SK – Informácie zverejňované ročne (Pillar 3, Opatrenie NBS 16/2014)
why_relevant: ČSOB's annual prudential disclosure series with a stable folder id (11005/98584) and date-suffixed filenames — enumerable back-run for capital/risk trend tracking.

source_name: 365.bank – Investori
why_relevant: Investor/disclosure entry point of 365.bank (ex-Poštová banka group head) — the fourth-largest domestic retail franchise; hosts regulatory and financial disclosures.

source_name: 365.bank – Výročné správy (annual & consolidated reports)
why_relevant: Consolidated annual reports contain the risk-management and capital-adequacy chapters plus narrative on regulatory change absorbed in the year.

source_name: 365.bank – Obchodné podmienky a sadzobník poplatkov (change series)
why_relevant: 365.bank posts date-stamped T&C and fee-schedule versions (personal-account changes and fee revision effective 1.3.2026; instant-payment limit raised 3k→5k EUR) — concrete evidence of instant-payments regulation landing in retail pricing.

source_name: Prima banka Slovensko – Výročné správy / ročné finančné správy
why_relevant: Domestic retail bank (Penta) with a clean, long back-run of annual and 'ročná finančná správa' PDFs including corporate-governance and capital-adequacy sections; useful comparator to the systemic four.

source_name: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka (SZRB) – Dokumenty
why_relevant: State promotional bank's document register (sadzobník poplatkov, obchodné podmienky) — non-private but a useful control for how the same regulatory changes are worded by a state-owned institution.

source_name: Erste Group Bank AG – Regulatory Reports (Pillar 3)
why_relevant: Group-consolidated Pillar 3 for SLSP's parent — supplies SREP/capital-requirement context and often discloses subsidiary-level buffers and MREL before the SK entity publishes.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Zverejnenia (statutory disclosure PDF folder)
why_relevant: Dedicated '/zverejnenia/' asset folder holding statutory disclosure lists (e.g. list of Erste Group banks used for payment services) that are referenced from T&C — the machine-readable annexes regulation forces banks to keep current.

source_name: ČSOB SK – Novinky (corporate news incl. regulatory-change notices)
why_relevant: Bank's own news feed announcing condition changes, product-regulatory adaptations and effective dates in plain language — good early-warning layer above the PDF register.

source_name: Opatrenie NBS č. 16/2014 (úplné znenie) – disclosure obligation instrument
why_relevant: The legal instrument that defines what every SK bank must disclose and on what frequency — the schema behind all the Pillar 3 documents above, and the key to knowing when a disclosure is late or missing.

source_name: FinStat – bank company profiles & filed financial statements (účtovné závierky)
why_relevant: Aggregator surfacing each bank's filed statutory accounts, legal-name history (Poštová banka → 365.bank) and register data — useful for entity resolution and for catching filings before banks post them on their own sites.

source_name: Third-party financial media coverage of SK bank T&C/fee changes (SITA vofinanciach, Index SME)
why_relevant: Slovak financial press reliably reports bank T&C and fee-schedule changes at announcement time (e.g. 365.bank's 1.3.2026 changes, instant-payment go-live dates), giving earlier and better-dated signal than crawling PDF folders alone.
